items.item: Signals are named, bounded numbers the page measures; a program cannot set one
items.evidence: src/lib/face/signals.ts; sound.test.ts 'a signal is kept inside its bounds...', 'only what is away from nothing is reported'

items.item: A `follow` step ties a channel to a signal, for a time or for as long as the performance holds; a wrong signal or channel is refused by path
items.evidence: src/lib/face/program.ts, player.ts; sound.test.ts 'a channel tied to a signal moves as the signal does...', 'with `for` the tie lasts that long...', 'a performance that keeps its hold keeps its ties', 'a signal nobody measures...'

items.item: A rule with `until` gives the face a form on its own layer, held from one event to another, never left out by chance
items.evidence: src/lib/face/reactions.ts, layers.ts, engine.ts; sound.test.ts 'sound starting gives the face a form, held until the sound stops', 'a form is never left out by chance, and both forms turn up'

items.item: The face still reacts and performs over a form, does not sleep while one is held, and reports it in its state
items.evidence: sound.test.ts 'the face still reacts over a form...', 'a form keeps the face from falling asleep...'; state().form

items.item: A feature's matter can be gathered into rings or bars
items.evidence: src/lib/face/feature.ts, channels.ts; sound.test.ts 'rings gather the matter into that many bands...', 'bars gather it into that many rows', 'with neither, a feature is filled as it always was'

items.item: The boombox form: ringed speakers, a deck with reels, a dial, moving with the sound's bands
items.evidence: src/lib/face/book.ts; sound.test.ts 'as a loudspeaker it has a deck and a dial...'; evidence/theo-sound/boombox.png, boombox-light.png

items.item: Arcs leave both sides by how loud the sound is, drawn outside the visor and clear of the words
items.evidence: emit.left/right in channels.ts; driver.ts emit, formSize; face-stage.tsx; .face-waves in styles.css; boombox.png (face 34..107 px, words from 133 px)

items.item: The mouth form opens by the level of audio really playing and shuts in a pause
items.evidence: book.ts speak; sound.test.ts 'as a mouth it opens by how loud the sound is...'; evidence/theo-sound/speak.png

items.item: With motion reduced nothing follows; that something is sounding is shown by still arcs
items.evidence: player.ts follow, engine.ts emitting; sound.test.ts 'with motion reduced, nothing follows', 'with motion reduced the loudspeaker does not pump...'; evidence/theo-sound/reduced-motion.png

items.item: One audio graph for the page: streamed blocks played back to back, an audio file, cancel; outputs only
items.evidence: src/lib/sound/graph.ts; exercised in the browser by the story (reading.png) and by the stop check recorded in theo-sound.md, not by a unit test: happy-dom has no Web Audio

items.item: A meter reads level, three bands and a beat, and says when sound starts, stops and gets loud; a pause with more due is not a stop
items.evidence: src/lib/sound/meter.ts; meter.test.ts (9)

items.item: The driver feeds the face the signals and events each frame; nothing reads a microphone
items.evidence: driver.ts hear; graph.ts has no input node; in the browser a played tone gave sound.start, the form, and sound.stop

items.item: A speech provider seam: text in, raw audio out, keyed or not
items.evidence: src/lib/speech/provider.ts; adapter.test.ts uses a provider of its own

items.item: Phonon 31M English runs in the browser with no key, fetched on first use
items.evidence: src/lib/speech/phonon.ts; phonon-tts 0.6.0 in package.json; in headless Chromium the model (65,049,306 bytes) was fetched and the story's reply read to the end

items.item: A reply is spoken as it would be read aloud
items.evidence: src/lib/speech/speakable.ts; speakable.test.ts (10)

items.item: assistant-ui's speech adapter over the seam: starting until audio is on its way, running, ended; one at a time; cancel
items.evidence: src/lib/speech/adapter.ts, wired in src/lib/theorem/runtime.tsx; adapter.test.ts (5)

items.item: Read aloud on an assistant message, saying when the voice is being fetched, and Stop reading while it reads
items.evidence: src/components/chat/read-aloud.tsx, thread.aui.tsx, icons.tsx; evidence/theo-sound/reading.png; Stop reading silenced the voice and Theo was at rest within 0.5 s

items.item: The manual lists the signals; face.perform and face.define mention `follow` and `until` inside Theorem's limits
items.evidence: engine.ts manual; operations.ts (face.perform 1006 bytes of 1024); sound.test.ts 'the manual says what can be followed...'; operations.test.ts 'what a turn declares'

items.item: The production build takes the voice package
items.evidence: NITRO_PRESET=cloudflare_module bun --bun vite build finished; worker and wasm emitted as public assets, none in the server bundle

items.item: A provider the person brings a key for (ElevenLabs or similar)
items.evidence: Not built. Where the key is kept is the owner's decision and comes first; see theo-sound.md, Not yet

items.item: The voice heard from the deployed build
items.evidence: Not run. The build finishes; the voice has been heard only from the development server
